_comment: Complete, reproducible build recipe for one ROM+device pair. Every value here is either frozen by the stock ROM (must not change) or verified against a recorded build. See README.md. This is the SOURCE-SIDE recipe (how to build this ROM's kernel). The delivery-side record (release manifest + userspace config) lives in the private maintenance repo; overlap between the two is intentional.

banner.uts_version: #1 SMP PREEMPT Mon Dec 8 17:59:01 UTC 2025 f2fs-hash:f7f0f9542b0
banner.note: Frozen by the stock ROM. Every value must reproduce byte-for-byte: uname -r / uname -v are world-readable and part of the observable interface. KBUILD_BUILD_F2FS_HASH is only honoured because scripts/mkcompile_h was patched in this tree; without that patch the hash is computed from our f2fs sources and comes out as c38b0fe53dd instead of f7f0f9542b0.

compiler.id: Android (6877366 based on r383902b1) clang version 11.0.2

reproducibility.note: The Image must be byte-identical wherever the tree and the output directory live. Without this, a hash recorded in a release manifest cannot be reproduced from a fresh clone.
reproducibility.mechanism: clang leaks the build location twice: it records the compile working directory in every object (feeding the ThinLTO module hash), and it writes the source path exactly as given into the object's section names. Prefix maps rewrite the first but not the second, so what decides whether two builds agree is whether those strings are equal. With the output directory inside the tree, kbuild sets srctree=".." and passes a relative source path, identical everywhere; build.sh then maps both the tree root and the output directory to fixed strings with -fdebug-prefix-map and -ffile-prefix-map, on KAFLAGS as well as KCFLAGS because assembly does not pass through KBUILD_CFLAGS.
reproducibility.constraint: OUT must be inside the tree. An out-of-tree O= always passes absolute source paths and cannot be made reproducible with this toolchain; build.sh refuses it rather than producing a hash that only matches on one machine.
reproducibility.verify: Build the same commit from two different tree paths into two differently-named output directories; Image and Module.symvers sha256 must match.

bakasu_integrated_tree_note: Tree hash of the BakaSU submodule after applying kernel-patches/0001. Upstream 5b76b884 alone does not build on 5.4.
susfs_note: Reference only. Upstream has no 5.4 branch (kernel-5.4 stopped 2025-02-23), so the working 5.4 SUSFS is hand-backported and committed in-tree as fs/susfs.c + include/linux/susfs{,def}.h. The submodule is kept for diffing against upstream, not for building.

rom_source.stock_config_note: Extracted from boot.img IKCONFIG; byte-identical to device /proc/config.gz
